reading.title: Ana Follows the Map
reading.purpose: Follow Ana and Dad as they use a map.
paras: Ana and Dad looked at a map of the park. A small tent was the symbol for the campground. Ana chose a route past the big oak tree. The tree was a landmark.
The distance was short, and the direction was east. A fence marked the border of the park. At home, Ana turned the globe and found the ocean.

qs.q: The oak tree was a landmark. What is a landmark?
choices: A place that is easy to recognize.
qs.why: A big oak tree is easy to recognize, so it is a landmark.

qs.q: What did the tent symbol stand for?
qs.why: The reading says a small tent was the symbol for the campground.

qs.q: What did Ana find on the globe?
qs.why: The reading says Ana turned the globe and found the ocean.
